evidence: SDK counterexamples; refusal, incompatible and unknown are distinct outcomes. No successful instrument receipt is claimed.

about: The wire is a lock. Its fields, their alphabets and forms, and the algorithms its digests and signatures name are lines of that lock, each with the epoch it was signed at; a claim is read by the lock as it stood when the claim was signed.

A field the lock does not name is refused. A field the lock closed reads a claim of its own time as history and refuses a later one. A line signed before the lock had any line is history: read, never judged by rules that came after it.

at carries only the wire's classes; needs is a region, a coordinate prefix at its resolution, never a path; sig names its algorithm by the digest of the blob that defines it, and a digest names its own algorithm from the digest lock.
The wire that reads a claim of one epoch folds the lock of that epoch, not a grammar remembered beside it.

about: The points every reading over the wire's forms takes: for each form, the parameters of the lattice of the algebra it is read in, a seed and how many points.

The check is the algebra's own, handed on; it runs over the points and over three broken copies of each lattice, its meet taken as its join, its order reversed and one law removed by taking its top as its bottom. A copy the check passes is a form it cannot see.

coverage.criterion: one case per form the wire writes, each with points enough to make a triple mean something
coverage.why: a sample of each lattice, not every element of it; the three broken copies show the sample is wide enough to see a law break
